explanation: The pole is a retrospective lexical detector for the predicate vocabulary of technical and clinical claims, and it answers to word-forms rather than to meanings or register. (1) In any register and any syntactic role it fires on the intervention verbs and their inflections - cause(s/d/ing), prevent(s/ed/ing), stop(s/ped/ping), halt(ed), cure(s/d), treat(ed/ing), protect(s/ed), affect(s/ed), infect(s/ed), block(s/ed), inhibit(s/ed), suppress(es/ed), eliminate(s/d), kill(s/ed), mitigate(s/d), alleviate(s/d), reduce(s/d) - on the relational adjectives that grade a thing against a standard or an agent - resistant, susceptible, vulnerable, liable, tolerant, allergic, compatible, valid, identical, comparable, equivalent, similar, related, associated, stable, serious, minimal, worth, able, close - and on the nominals quality, detection, sensitivity and mechanism: 'a good cause', 'treated his guests to dinner', 'the old clock stopped' and 'the shop is close' fire as strongly as a journal sentence, so register and part of speech are not part of the feature. (2) Only inside technical or clinical prose does the same lift reach the further change- and method-words removed, returned, recovered, processed, sequenced, assayed, effective, reliable and consistent, which stay near its floor in a narrative sentence with the same word. (3) Everywhere it stays below 0.35 for entity nouns (protein, tissue, hospital, committee), for absolute harm and severity adjectives (harmful, toxic, dangerous, sensitive, prone, immune, chronic, acute, mild, significant) and for narrative or plain-reporting verbs (walked, talked, played, made, gave, used, said, started, ended, continued, spread, persisted, failed, improved, increased, declined, changed, measured, tested, observed, reported, monitored, analysed, assessed, examined, described). Peaks run 0.9-2.2 in a plain sentence and 1.5-3.2 when the trigger is the predicate of a that/which relative clause, and a probe's strength is the maximum over its tokens, so one trigger anywhere in the sentence carries it. The pole's output lens is incoherent (whitespace tokens under the Jacobian lens, 0% logit/Jacobian agreement, kurtosis 99.6), so no upcoming-token set is claimed.
